nodes.description: Owner address declared in Owned; assigned msg.sender in the Owned constructor and changed only through the two-step ownership transfer.
Pending owner address used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership flow.
Public token symbol string set to "ECASH" in the ECASH constructor.
Public token name string set to "ECASH" in the ECASH constructor.
Public token decimals value set to 18 in the ECASH constructor.
Total token supply, set to 500000000 * 10^18 in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) holding token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances.
Pure helper performing addition with a require(c >= a) overflow guard.
Pure helper performing subtraction with a require(b <= a) underflow guard.
Pure helper performing multiplication with an overflow guard.
Pure helper performing division with a require(b > 0) guard.
Constructor of Owned that initializes owner with msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner; ownership is not effective until acceptOwnership.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner and clears newOwner.
Token constructor; sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and credits the full supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no double-spend protection.
Moves tokens from `from` to `to` while decrementing allowed[from][msg.sender]; note the allowance check is only implicit through safeSub.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets the allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract, forwarding data.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract to recover tokens.
Caller-controlled address used as owner initializer, allowance key, balance key and access-control subject.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed inside approveAndCall on an attacker-controlled contract address.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary contract supplied by the owner.
Arithmetic update balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic update balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transfer.
Arithmetic updates balances[from] = safeSub(...) and allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(...) inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic update balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) inside transferFrom.
Access-control check require(msg.sender == owner) in the onlyOwner modifier.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Token amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Token amount parameter of approve.
Source account parameter of transferFrom.
Destination account parameter of transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender/callee contract address parameter of approveAndCall; becomes the callee of receiveApproval.
Token amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Arbitrary bytes data parameter of approveAndCall forwarded to receiveApproval.
Address of the arbitrary ERC20 token contract used in transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
Proposed new owner parameter of transferOwnership.
Account whose balance is queried in balanceOf.
Allowance owner parameter of allowance.
Allowance spender parameter of allowance.

approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender into the external call.

transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before taking ownership.
msg.sender is the value compared against owner in the ownership check.

transferAnyERC20Token evaluates the onlyOwner require check before executing.

acceptOwnership assigns owner = newOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: The transfer recipient parameter only exists to feed the transfer function's balance update.
The transfer amount parameter is consumed exclusively by the balance subtraction operation.
The approve spender parameter exists only to key the allowed mapping written by approve.
The approve amount parameter exists only to set the allowance value in approve.
The transferFrom from-address parameter is only used to debit balances and allowances.
The transferFrom to-address parameter is only used to credit the recipient balance.
The transferFrom amount parameter is consumed by the subtraction operation on balance and allowance.
The spender parameter becomes the callee address of the external receiveApproval call.
The approveAndCall amount parameter only sets the allowance written by approveAndCall.
The data parameter is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The tokenAddress parameter becomes the callee of the external ERC20 transfer call.
The tokens parameter only supplies the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
The _newOwner parameter only feeds the transferOwnership state update.
The tokenOwner parameter only indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The allowance tokenOwner parameter only reads the allowed mapping outer key.
The allowance spender parameter only reads the allowed mapping inner key.
